response.content: {"critique": "The problem is that claims handlers must manually call each supplier to check garage repair progress. I reviewed the five most similar items: Policyholder milestone notifications (policyholder-facing, not supplier repair status), Supplier contact details (completed story about syncing contact info, not repair progress), Claims timeline (chronological claim events, not supplier repair status), Supplier directory (directory management, not progress tracking), and Task overview (internal task dashboard).
